literal_meaning: যেমন কথা বলা হয়েছে তেমনই (কথোপকথনের অনুসারে বা যথাসম্ভব)
figurative_meaning_bn: যে কোনো উপায়ে; যে কোনো রূপে
figurative_meaning_en: In any way; in any form
example_sentences_in_english: He will solve the problem by any means.
We will go to the party come what may.
history: Derived from classical Sanskrit-Bengali literary traditions, often used in older texts to denote flexibility in action.
note: This is an archaic idiom, less common in modern colloquial Bengali but preserved in literary contexts.
